assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI sprite atlas, square 2048x2048. Create precisely 16 separate illustrated icons in a perfectly regular 4 by 4 grid of equal square cells. Painterly realistic royal Vietnamese / East Asian imperial court game, sumptuous sculpted antique gold with warm ivory highlights, carved details, subtle bronze shadow, tiny jade and vermilion accents. Readable bold silhouettes at 40 pixels, premium game inventory illustrations, no flat vector outlines. Illustration painting like lavish historical game UI, not SVG, not geometrical vector lines.
